words.definition: a soft pad used for sitting or leaning on for comfort
words.example: The lounge chairs come with an extra cushion for comfort.
words.exampleTranslation: 這些休閒椅附有一個額外的靠墊，增加舒適度。

words.definition: a measured quantity of medicine to be taken at one time
words.example: The pharmacist explained the correct dose for the medication.
words.exampleTranslation: 藥師說明了這款藥物的正確劑量。

words.definition: to generate or create something through active effort, as in "drum up"
words.translation: 招攬；炒熱（常用於 drum up）
words.example: The marketing team is trying to drum up interest before the launch.
words.exampleTranslation: 行銷團隊正努力在上市前炒熱話題。

words.definition: to fix something firmly into a surrounding mass or place it within something
words.example: A tracking chip is embedded in each shipping container.
words.exampleTranslation: 每個貨櫃裡都嵌入了一個追蹤晶片。

words.definition: to remove people from a dangerous place to a safer one
words.example: Staff were asked to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工在消防演習期間被要求撤離大樓。

words.definition: to make a process happen more quickly
words.example: We paid extra to expedite the delivery of the parts.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們額外付費以加快零件的送達速度。

words.definition: a device used to put out a fire
words.example: Every floor of the office must have a fire extinguisher.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室每一層樓都必須配置滅火器。

words.definition: close acquaintance with or good knowledge of something
words.example: Her familiarity with the software made training the new hires easy.
words.exampleTranslation: 她對這套軟體的熟悉讓訓練新進員工變得容易。

words.definition: a mark, imperfection, or fault that spoils something
words.example: Quality control found a flaw in the packaging design.
words.exampleTranslation: 品管在包裝設計中發現了一個瑕疵。

words.definition: to rise and fall irregularly in amount or level
words.example: Fuel prices tend to fluctuate throughout the year.
words.exampleTranslation: 燃油價格全年往往會有波動。

words.definition: able to speak or write a language easily and accurately
words.example: Being fluent in Mandarin gave her an advantage in the interview.
words.exampleTranslation: 她流利的華語能力讓她在面試中占優勢。

words.definition: in a truthful and sincere manner
words.example: Honestly, the proposal needs more supporting data.
words.exampleTranslation: 老實說，這份提案需要更多支持的數據。

words.definition: to do the cleaning and other domestic or maintenance work for a place
words.example: The hotel hired extra staff to housekeep during the busy season.
words.exampleTranslation: 飯店在旺季雇用了額外的人員做客房清潔。

words.definition: a severe tropical storm with very strong winds
words.example: Flights were delayed for two days because of the hurricane.
words.exampleTranslation: 因為颶風，班機延誤了兩天。

words.definition: conditions and practices that help maintain health and cleanliness
words.example: The restaurant received top marks for kitchen hygiene.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間餐廳的廚房衛生獲得最高評分。

words.definition: necessary to make something complete; essential
words.translation: 不可或缺的；構成整體的
words.example: Customer feedback is integral to improving the product.
words.exampleTranslation: 顧客回饋對於改善產品是不可或缺的。

words.definition: allowing a two-way flow of information or response between a user and a system
words.example: The new kiosk features an interactive touchscreen menu.
words.exampleTranslation: 這台新的自助服務機有互動式觸控螢幕菜單。

words.definition: to intervene in a way that hinders or disrupts something
words.example: Personal matters should not interfere with your work schedule.
words.exampleTranslation: 私人事務不應該干擾你的工作行程。

words.definition: a metric unit of mass equal to 1,000 grams
words.example: Excess baggage over twenty kilograms will incur a fee.
words.exampleTranslation: 超過二十公斤的行李將會收取費用。

words.definition: a temporary or permanent dismissal of an employee from a job
words.example: The company announced a round of layoffs last quarter.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司在上一季宣布了一輪裁員。
